label: Taktgenerator

semantics.notes: Tick-based frequency generator. Generates periodic clock pulses. Frequency adjustable 0.1–100 Hz. Uses SIM_TICKS_PER_SEC for tick-accurate timing.

exportSupport.verilogNotes: UI signal generator — no HDL export.
exportSupport.vhdlNotes: UI signal generator — no HDL export.

testability.notes: Verify clock output toggles at the set frequency. Pause/resume capability.

modelLimits: Frequency is user-configurable, not deterministic in tests.
